description: One-call LABELING launch: creates a job draft plus a linked labeling project in a single request, optionally publishing the job immediately. Accepts job fields (same contract as PATCH /job-drafts/{id}), a project spec (name, projectType, instructions, labelConfigXml), an optional budgetUsd (validated against the prepaid credit balance — a 402 means top up credits first; money still moves only at hire through escrow), and publish: true|false. Returns jobId, projectId, and concrete next steps (add data, publish/kick off matching, launch the work session after hiring). Requires jobs:write + open-label:write scopes.
name: opentrain_launch_label_work
